_note: Provider knowledge, not brand knowledge. A quirk is what a specific model gets reliably wrong regardless of what you are making. It attaches to the PROVIDER, so it applies whether a generator pinned that provider or merely resolved to it at run time. Universes do not own this file; the framework does, and every universe benefits when one project learns something.

quirks.seen: When a person is depicted drawing, holding, or displaying a picture, the depicted picture renders upside down relative to the viewer.
quirks.counter: Any picture, page, book, drawing, or artwork shown INSIDE the scene must be RIGHT SIDE UP and correctly oriented to the viewer. Never inverted, never rotated, never upside down.

quirks.seen: Realistic or semi-realistic hands frequently render with six fingers.
quirks.counter: Every hand has EXACTLY four fingers plus one thumb, five digits total.
